prayerExcerpt.en-US: Whoever follows me will not walk in darkness, but will have the light of life, says the Lord.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Quem me segue não andará nas trevas, mas terá a luz da vida, diz o Senhor.

meta.face: A South Indian man of about forty (he died at thirty-nine) with a warm, deep-brown complexion and a BROAD, SQUARE face — a wide, LOW forehead, strong, FLAT cheekbones, a STRAIGHT, broad nose with a LOW bridge and full, rounded nostrils, large, dark, deep-set eyes under THICK, straight black brows that nearly meet, a wide, full-lipped mouth and a strong, square jaw; thick, wavy black hair falling to the shoulders and a FULL, dense black beard trimmed ROUND at the chin; the gaze lifted in prayer. Not a long oval face, not Christ-like.
meta.basis: No likeness from life survives (he died in 1752). The traditional image (the Dicastery's picture for his canonization; the painting and the statue in Kottar cathedral on Wikimedia Commons) shows a black-haired, full-bearded man kneeling bare-chested in a white veshti with chains at his wrists; the card keeps its hair, beard and dress, covers the chest with a shawl, and gives the face a broad, square Tamil structure so it cannot read as Christ.
